column1: # Game profile of Pokémon Shield (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.3.2 = v458752). Plays on the iPhone
# Pokémon Sword's twin (0100ABF008968000): the same engine and the same sdk, subsdk0 (movie) and subsdk1 (GLSLC) builds; only main is its own build. Game Freak's engine (the one before Trinity)
# on SDK 7.3.2, NVN, Wwise, Pia / NEX networking, with Silicon Studio's YEBIS post effects. Made from Sword's profile with Shield's title, build row and shader tables
# the camera is on the right stick
# No virtual address memory (the NPDM declares no system resource): nninitStartup sets a 3.13 GB heap in the 4 GB layout
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (main 25 MB of text, GLSLC 4.8 MB)
# the BNSH entries of the GFPAK archives under bin/archive (LZ4 entries, shader_split.py gfpak_members), the loose BNSH files of bin/battle, bin/graphics and system_resource/shader,
# two BNSH in main, and YEBIS's post effects, a .tfxo file in a zlib stream in main (tfxo_streams)
